title: Positive Mass Theorem with Arbitrary Ends and Noncompact Boundary
summary: We prove a positive mass theorem for complete Riemannian manifolds with noncompact boundary, a distinguished asymptotically flat half-space end, and finitely many additional complete ends with no prescribed asymptotics. If $3\leq n\leq7$, $R_g\geq0$, and $H_{\partial M}\geq0$, then $ \mathfrak m(M,g,\mathcal E)\geq0$. Moreover, equality holds if and only if $(M,g)$ is isometric to the Euclidean half-space.
